  if (nzchar(caption_txt)) cat(sprintf("\n*%s*\n\n", caption_txt))
}

anova_all <- bind_rows(anova_list)
if (nrow(anova_all) > 0) {
  cat(as_raw_html(apa_gt(anova_all, "Welch One-Way ANOVA by Channel")))
  cat(sprintf("\n*%s*\n\n", "__CAPTION_WELCH_ANOVA__"))
}
pw_all <- bind_rows(pw_list)
if (nrow(pw_all) > 0) {
  cat(as_raw_html(apa_gt(pw_all, "Pairwise Comparisons (Games-Howell) by Channel")))
  cat(sprintf("\n*%s*\n\n", "__CAPTION_GAMES_HOWELL__"))
}
```
